aggregation: object mean per pair; pair mean per sequence; equal sequence mean
correspondence: independent hard cosine nearest in each direction; no temperature search
hyperparameter_tie_rule: within 1e-12: lower write rate, higher threshold, stronger alpha
write_rule: argmax among 15 non-OFF; strict predicted reward > threshold, else OFF
frame_rule: first source, floor(n/3) and floor(2*n/3) targets from sorted annotated frame-index metadata
missing_rule: fail closed for corrupt/missing frame or unsupported source; do not replace after selection or evaluate incomplete cohort
external_domain: VOST object transformations, Ego4D/EPIC-KITCHENS source; cross-dataset confirmation
protected_policy: never open existing reserve or DAVIS official validation
